opis: AI provider layer for an agent that fixes failing builds after dependency upgrades. All entries use OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, so switching providers changes the base_url, secret, and model only. Secret names, never values.

lancuch.uwaga_format: Each role accepts a provider name or a list of names tried in order. This makes adding another fallback a data change rather than a code change.

domyslne_parametry.uwaga_max_tokens: Reasoning tokens count as output and are included in max_tokens. If max_tokens is too small, the response returns empty with finish_reason=length — measured empirically on DeepSeek, Gemini through OpenRouter, and Kimi.
domyslne_parametry.uwaga_parametry: A provider can override any of these parameters in its own 'parametry' block. This is not cosmetic: Kimi rejects a temperature other than 1 with HTTP 400, so without the override it would never return a response.

deepseek.notatka: Primary access point. Cheap, fast, with an empirically confirmed OpenAI-compatible API. First attempt for every failed build.

deepseek-pro.notatka: Harder case: Flash did not respond, returned an error, or returned empty. It uses the same key and base_url as Flash — escalation changes only the model name. It is three times more expensive than Flash and has a lower concurrency limit (500 vs. 2500).

openrouter.notatka: Emergency fallback when DeepSeek is unavailable (429, 5xx, provider outage). It has an independent provider and key, so a DeepSeek outage does not affect it. It also provides access to Gemini models without a Google key — confirmed empirically.

kimi.notatka: Second independent fallback, after OpenRouter. It is the third provider and third key in the chain, so neither a DeepSeek nor OpenRouter outage affects it. A code-specialized model at the price of the general kimi-k2.6 model (the same 0.95/4.00), so the specialization costs nothing. Its global host is api.moonshot.ai; api.moonshot.cn rejects this key with 401. Two required parameter overrides apply: temperature must be 1 (any other value returns HTTP 400) and max_tokens must exceed the default 4096, because at 4096 the response can be empty with finish_reason=length — measured. The account is in the lowest limits tier (RPM 3, concurrency 1), which is another reason it is a fallback rather than the default.
